comment: Games with a Discord quest currently running.
This file is intentionally empty in the repository: quest availability
changes constantly and stale entries are worse than none.
Populate it by editing 'entries' below, or host an updated copy and set
'remote' to its raw URL so the app can refresh without a new release.
Each entry needs 'name' matching a catalogue entry exactly (the Discord
application name, not the wiki spelling). 'until' is an optional ISO 8601
date; entries past it are ignored. 'reward' is free text shown in the UI.
